Paper to digital

Scan your paper logbook.

Photograph a page and everyPilot reads it, then checks every row against the page's own totals. You confirm each line before anything is saved.

  • Reads on the phone, with no account and no upload to us
  • Checks "totals this page" and "brought forward"

Log your first 100 flights free; imported flights never count. One purchase unlocks unlimited logging for good. Viewing, printing, exporting and backups are always free.

Questions pilots ask

Can I bring my logbook from another app?

Yes. everyPilot imports exports from other logbook apps and CSV files, shows every column before saving, and compares the totals so you can see they match.

What happens to my data if everyPilot stops being developed?

Nothing breaks. There is no server to switch off. Your logbook is on your phone and in your own cloud, and you can export it or make a full backup at any time, free.

Is there an Android version?

It is in testing on Google Play. The community page explains how to join the test.

Is everyPilot approved by an aviation authority?

No. everyPilot is a record-keeping tool, not approved flight-planning or flight-time-limitation software. Check its calculations against your regulations, your operator's manuals and your own records.

Who makes it?

One pilot, Eyinsan Odugba. Feature requests and problem reports go to the community page, and they are read.
